comment: SHA-256 of the pinned Xray-core release: the archives published at https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core/releases and the executables committed under resources/xray/<platform>/<arch>/. `npm run xray:download*` installs nothing that differs from these, and `npm run xray:ensure` (run by package:prepare) fails when a committed executable does. To move to a newer release, change pinnedVersion in scripts/download-xray-runtime.mjs, run `npm run xray:download-all -- --trust-download` to record it, compare the archive values against the release's .dgst files, and commit this file with the new binaries.
